name: Rule 1 — current + grade point average (text)
label: What is your current cumulative grade point average?
spec_quote: The label contains the word "current" or "present" and, within the next 40 characters (no "?" in between), "GPA" (as a word) or "grade point average" — e.g. "What is your current cumulative grade point average?"

name: Rule 1 — current GPA with parenthetical (text)
label: Current GPA (if applicable)
spec_quote: e.g. ... "Current GPA (if applicable)" ... The answer is the text "N/A".

name: Rule 1 — present GPA (textarea)
label: Please enter your present GPA
spec_quote: e.g. ... "Please enter your present GPA". The answer is the text "N/A".

name: Rule 1 near miss — GPA more than 40 chars after 'current'
label: Current enrollment status, degree program, and cumulative GPA
spec_quote: "current" or "present" must come before "GPA" / "grade point average" and it must be within the next 40 characters ... Any other GPA question → GPA_ON_FILE: the label contains "GPA" as a word ... and rule 1 does not apply

name: Rule 1 near miss — '?' between current and GPA
label: Current student? Please provide your cumulative GPA
spec_quote: within the next 40 characters (no "?" in between) ... Any other GPA question → GPA_ON_FILE: the label contains "GPA" as a word ... and rule 1 does not apply

name: Rule 2 — current undergraduate GPA
label: Current undergraduate GPA
spec_quote: A label that mentions "undergrad" / "undergraduate" / "under grad", "bachelor", "bachelor's" or "high school" anywhere is never rule 1, even with "current" — e.g. "Current undergraduate GPA" → GPA_ON_FILE (rule 3).

name: Rule 2 — current GPA in bachelor's program
label: What is your current GPA in your bachelor's program?
spec_quote: A label that mentions ... "bachelor" ... anywhere is never rule 1, even with "current"

name: Rule 2 — present high school grade point average
label: Present high school grade point average
spec_quote: A label that mentions ... "high school" anywhere is never rule 1, even with "current"

name: Rule 3 — GPA appears before 'current'
label: GPA (current or most recent)
spec_quote: "GPA (current or most recent)"? — no: here "current" is followed by " or most recent)" and then nothing; "GPA" comes BEFORE "current", so rule 1 (which needs "current" first, then GPA) does not apply → GPA_ON_FILE.

name: Rule 3 — plain past-tense GPA question
label: What was your GPA?
spec_quote: Any other GPA question → GPA_ON_FILE: the label contains "GPA" as a word or "grade point average" and rule 1 does not apply — e.g. "GPA", "Cumulative GPA", "What was your GPA?"

name: Select — first exact N/A option
label: Current GPA (if applicable)
spec_quote: the pick is the first option that is exactly "N/A" or "NA" (slash optional)

name: Select — first exact NA beats later N/A
label: Please enter your present GPA
spec_quote: the pick is the first option that is exactly "N/A" or "NA" (slash optional)

name: Select — 'not applicable' when no exact NA/N/A
label: Current cumulative GPA

name: Select — option starting with 'N/A'
label: Current overall GPA
spec_quote: else one starting with "N/A", else one starting with "Other"

name: Select — option starting with 'Other'
label: What is your current grade point average?
spec_quote: else one starting with "N/A", else one starting with "Other"

name: Select — no matching option → none
label: Current GPA
spec_quote: if none of those exists the question is left unanswered (`none`)
